title: MACC human approval gate
description: The `gate` object of a task that only people may decide. The MACC coordinator never dispatches such a task to a performer; it waits in `waiting_approval` until the quorum is recorded with `macc coordinator approve`.

subject_task.description: Task whose delivered revision is approved. Must also be listed in the gate task's dependencies.

description.description: The decision being approved, in one sentence.

approval_trigger.description: Why people must decide. A gate without a trigger must not exist.

governance_ref.description: Repository path (optionally #anchor) of the specification governance source that defines the approver roles.

role.description: Role name exactly as the governance source defines it.

evidence_type.description: Where the durable human proof lives. Any value except manual makes --evidence mandatory on approval.
